intent: Eight individual emotion-noun tasks connect the correct activity, subject, possibility and outcome without unjustified guarantees.
picturePurpose: Original card/book/photo comparison supports object identification only. A learner-built coded boat illustrates building as an activity without claiming the source boat was finished or sailed successfully.

workshop.title: 动手搭小船，核对感受与结果
workshop.instruction: 装桅杆、挂帆、辨贺卡，再找准感受对应的事情。

items.label: pleasure：愉快的是听故事
items.prompt: 先找出什么事让人愉快。
items.material: It was a pleasure to hear your stories.
items.reason: It was a pleasure to do表示做某事很愉快；这里是听你的故事。a pleasure可指一件乐事；不要把名词pleasure换成形容词pleased或pleasant后仍保留a。

wordDecision.prompt: 先找出什么事让人愉快。

recordSelection.title: 乐事是听你的故事
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 听你的故事
rows.text: The speaker enjoyed hearing the listener’s stories.

rows.label: 自己讲故事
rows.text: The pleasure was telling the speaker’s own stories.

rows.label: 不喜欢听
rows.text: The speaker disliked hearing the stories.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选听你的故事；别换动作、对象或感受。

options.text: Hearing the listener’s stories was a pleasure.
options.reason: to hear your stories是愉快的事情，不是自己讲故事。

options.text: The speaker says telling their own stories was the pleasure.
options.reason: 把hear换成tell，还把your换成自己的。

options.text: The speaker disliked hearing the stories.
options.reason: pleasure表示愉快，与disliked相反。

items.label: fun：动手造船时很开心
items.prompt: 先装桅杆，再挂帆。原句能证明试航成功吗？
items.material: We had fun building the little boat.
items.reason: have fun doing表示做某事很开心，fun在这个结构里不用a，后面接building，不接to build。原句说造船时的感受，没有交代造船是否完成或试航是否成功。示意模型由你来搭，不替原句补结果。
items.hint: 先搭模型，再分过程感受和完成结果。

wordDecision.prompt: 先装桅杆，再挂帆。原句能证明试航成功吗？

boat.title: 把桅杆和帆装到船身上
boat.hint: 先装桅杆，再挂帆；你搭的是示意模型，感受仍按原句判断。
boat.wrong: 先装好桅杆和帆，再保留造船时很开心；不能补成已经试航成功。

options.text: The sentence proves the finished boat sailed successfully.
options.reason: 造船过程开心，不证明造好或试航成功。

options.text: The group was bored with building the boat.
options.reason: bored与had fun表达的感受不同。

options.text: The group enjoyed building the little boat.
options.reason: had fun doing表示做某事很开心。

items.label: surprise：找贺卡，不靠图片猜惊喜
items.prompt: 点出贺卡，再看文字说明它带来的感受。
items.material: The handmade card was a lovely surprise.
items.before: The handmade card was a lovely
items.reason: surprise在a lovely surprise中是名词，指惊喜。handmade修饰card，lovely说明这是令人愉快的惊喜。图片只帮助辨认贺卡、书和照片；是否手工制作以及带来的感受，都按文字判断。
items.hint: 物品看形状，handmade和惊喜看文字。

wordDecision.prompt: 点出贺卡，再看文字说明它带来的感受。

art.alt: 桌上三个物品：左侧折叠贺卡、右下方蓝色精装书、右上方一张风景照片。

evidence.caption: 折叠的纸卡是card。是否手工制作以及惊喜的感受，由原句说明。
B有书脊和成叠书页，是book，不是card。
C是一张平放的照片，不是折叠贺卡。

options.text: The blue hardback book is the object named in the record.
options.reason: book不是card。

options.text: The folded greeting card is the object named in the record.
options.reason: 图中折叠贺卡对应card；handmade和惊喜由文字说明。

options.text: The flat photograph is the object named in the record.
options.reason: photograph不是card。

items.label: relief：找到之后如释重负
items.prompt: 找到狗后是什么感受？保留原句的信息。
items.material: Finding the missing dog was a huge relief.
items.before: Finding the missing dog was a huge
items.reason: relief是宽慰、如释重负的感觉；a relief可指让人宽慰的事情。Finding the missing dog是动名词短语作主语，谓语用was。原句没有交代是谁找到的，别补名字。

wordDecision.prompt: 找到狗后是什么感受？保留原句的信息。

recordSelection.title: 宽慰来自找到走失的狗
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 找到之后
rows.text: Finding the missing dog brought great relief.

rows.label: 只是将来承诺
rows.text: There is only a promise to search someday.

rows.label: 从未走失
rows.text: The dog had never been missing.

recordSelection.hint: 找到和宽慰相连；执行者没写。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选找到之后；别改成未来承诺或从未走失。

options.text: Finding the missing dog brought great relief.
options.reason: Finding the missing dog是带来宽慰的事情。

options.text: The sentence only promises to look for the dog someday.
options.reason: finding和was不是只承诺将来找。

options.text: The sentence says the dog had never been missing.
options.reason: missing明确写了走失，不是从未走失。

items.label: stress：can说可能，不是人人必然
items.prompt: 压力大就一定失眠吗？圈出原句支持的信息。
items.material: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep.
items.after: can make it hard to sleep.
items.reason: stress在too much stress中是不可数名词，表示压力。can说明可能，make it hard to sleep表示使入睡变难；不能扩大成所有人每晚都失眠，也不能据此诊断某个人。
items.hint: 保留can的范围，不把可能写成必然。

wordDecision.prompt: 压力大就一定失眠吗？圈出原句支持的信息。

recordSelection.title: can不等于每人每次必然
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 可能难以入睡
rows.text: Too much stress can make sleep difficult.

rows.label: 人人每晚失眠
rows.text: Every stressed person is unable to sleep every night.

rows.label: 更容易入睡
rows.text: Too much stress makes sleep easier.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选可能难以入睡；另外两条扩大范围或反转方向。

options.text: Every stressed person is guaranteed to be unable to sleep every night.
options.reason: 把可能扩大成所有人每晚必然如此。

options.text: Too much stress is said to make sleep easier.
options.reason: hard被改成easier，方向相反。

options.text: Excessive stress can make sleeping difficult.
options.reason: can表达可能；too much修饰压力。

items.label: confidence：小成功帮助建立信心
items.prompt: 小成功带来什么？别把帮助写成保证。
items.material: Small successes helped build her confidence.
items.reason: confidence是名词，confident是形容词。her confidence是她的信心；small successes是帮助建立信心的事情。helped build不保证从此每次都成功，也不能把successes换成failures。

wordDecision.prompt: 小成功带来什么？别把帮助写成保证。

recordSelection.title: 有信心不等于每次都成功
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 小成功帮忙
rows.text: Small successes helped build her confidence.

rows.label: 保证次次成功
rows.text: She is guaranteed to succeed at every task from now on.

rows.label: 只由失败带来
rows.text: Only failures are named as the cause.

recordSelection.hint: helped是帮助，不是保证未来结果。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选小成功帮忙；不能补永远成功或换成失败。

options.text: She is now guaranteed to succeed at every task.
options.reason: 有信心不等于以后做什么都必定成功。

options.text: Small successes helped develop her confidence.
options.reason: helped build说明对建立信心起到帮助。

options.text: Only failures are named as the source of confidence.
options.reason: 原句写successes，不是只写failures。

items.label: courage：承认错误需要勇气
items.prompt: 承认还是隐藏？找出需要勇气的动作。
items.material: It took courage to admit the mistake.
items.reason: It took courage to do表示做某事需要勇气；courage在这里是不可数名词，不加a。admit the mistake是承认错误，不是掩盖错误。原句没有交代是谁或后来是否受罚，不补这些信息。
items.hint: to admit定位动作，不补人物和后果。

wordDecision.prompt: 承认还是隐藏？找出需要勇气的动作。

recordSelection.title: 需要勇气的是承认错误
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 掩盖错误
rows.text: The sentence praises hiding the mistake.

rows.label: 确定受罚
rows.text: A named person was punished afterwards.

recordSelection.hint: admit是承认；人物和后果没有写。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选承认错误；别反转动作或编后果。

options.text: Admitting the mistake required courage.
options.reason: to admit the mistake是需要勇气的事情。

options.text: Hiding the mistake is the action praised in the sentence.
options.reason: admit是承认，不是隐藏。

options.text: The sentence proves a named person was punished afterwards.
options.reason: 没有姓名，也没有写后来的惩罚。

items.label: mood：改善，不等于永远开心
items.prompt: 这次好转，还是永远开心？保留原句的范围。
items.material: A short walk improved my mood.
items.reason: mood是心情；improved是improve的过去式，表示改善。原句报告短暂散步后的改善，没有说永远开心，也不能推出改善了多少分或走了几分钟。
items.hint: 保留改善方向，不编程度或永远保证。

wordDecision.prompt: 这次好转，还是永远开心？保留原句的范围。

recordSelection.title: 改善方向要保留
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 散步使心情改善
rows.text: A short walk improved the speaker’s mood.

rows.label: 永远不会难过
rows.text: The speaker can never feel bad again.

rows.label: 心情变差
rows.text: The walk made the speaker’s mood worse.

recordSelection.hint: 改善不等于永远开心；数值和时长没写。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选散步使心情改善；永远保证和反向变化都不成立。

options.text: The speaker can never feel bad again.
options.reason: 改善不保证永远没有坏心情。

options.text: The short walk made the mood worse.
options.reason: 把improved的方向反转了。

options.text: A short walk made the speaker’s mood better.
options.reason: improved是改善，my mood是我的心情。

transfer.stem: Which notes keep the process, possibility and improvement accurate?
transfer.passage:
CLASS MAKERS’ AFTERNOON
It was a pleasure to hear our visitors’ stories. We had fun building a little boat together. At four o’clock, it was still on the table: we had not tested whether it could sail. Before leaving, a visitor gave us a handmade card. What a lovely surprise!
Then we heard that the missing dog had been found near the gate. What a relief!
Hua smiled at her boat. ‘Small successes like this help build my confidence,’ she said. Our teacher added, ‘Too much stress can make it hard to sleep. Ask for help when you need it.’
It took courage to admit a mistake in our group’s plan. We listened and changed the plan together. Later, a short walk improved my mood. I still felt worried about tomorrow’s presentation, but I felt better than before.

options.text: The group enjoyed building without a successful sailing test; stress may affect sleep; the walk improved a mood without a permanent guarantee.
The boat definitely passed a sailing test; stress may affect sleep; the walk improved a mood without a permanent guarantee.
The group enjoyed building without a successful sailing test; stress always stops every student sleeping; the walk improved a mood without a permanent guarantee.
The group enjoyed building without a successful sailing test; stress may affect sleep; the walk means the speaker can never feel bad again.

answer.display: The group enjoyed building without a successful sailing test; stress may affect sleep; the walk improved a mood without a permanent guarantee.

explanation.strategy: 先看造船过程与试航记录，再保留can的可能，最后核对心情改善的限度。

steps.text: 造船时很开心，但还没有试航；压力可能影响睡眠，不等于所有人都睡不着。
steps.reason: had not tested排除试航记录；can保留可能性。

steps.text: 散步改善心情，不代表以后永远不会心情差。
steps.reason: improved只报告这次变化，末句仍然有担心，同时感觉比之前好。

distractors.reason: 尚未试航被改成已经试航成功。
can的可能被扩大成每个人必然如此。
本次改善被扩大成永远不会心情差。

explanation.pitfall: 把过程感受当成完成效果，把可能或本次改善扩大成无条件保证。
